_doc: Character staging pools, keyed by cast size. Templates use {c1}..{c4}. Register: lateral/relational placement only (photograph staging) — never scale or framing language, which belongs to the layout/composition layer. Soft cap 4: diffusion muddies past ~3 named subjects.

1: at the center of the frame, {c1}
one figure alone in the frame, {c1}
the frame held by a single presence, {c1}
2: to the left of the frame, {c1}; to the right, {c2}
on the near side of the frame, {c1}; a step behind, {c2}
{c1} to the left of the frame, {c2} to the right
facing one another across the frame, {c1} and {c2}
3: to the left, {c1}; at the center, {c2}; to the right, {c3}
{c1} and {c2} in the foreground, {c3} behind them
three figures across the frame: {c1} at the near left, {c2} at the center, {c3} at the far right
{c1} at the far left of the frame, {c2} at the center, {c3} at the far right
4: in the foreground, {c1} and {c2}; farther back, {c3} and {c4}
{c1} and {c2} to the left of the frame, {c3} and {c4} to the right
{c1} nearest the camera, {c2} beside them, {c3} and {c4} deeper in the frame
spread across the frame: {c1} at the far left, {c2} at the center left, {c3} at the center right, {c4} at the far right

bare._doc: Positioning-mode templates: sentence structure only, no placement language of their own — each character carries its own position phrase (scene-side positioning toggle / character roller).
